name: Asahi Diamond Industrial Co Ltd
summary: Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, and established in 1937, Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. is a global producer and supplier of specialized diamond and cubic boron nitride (CBN) tools. The company serves a diverse international clientele spanning Japan, other Asian nations, Oceania, Europe, and North America. Its extensive product portfolio caters to a range of industries. For the electronics and semiconductor sector, they furnish items such as diamond and cutting wheels, electroplated diamond wires and band saws, CMP conditioners, diamond dies, scribers, and precision grinding wheels. Within the transportation sector, they provide a variety of tools, including diamond and CBN wheels, cutting wheels, different types of diamond dressers, turning tools, drills, end mills, reamers, and precision grinding wheels. Their machinery offerings encompass diamond and CBN wheels, diamond dressers, wire guide dies, water jet nozzles, wear-resistant implements, precision grinding wheels, and super-finishing grinding stones. Additionally, their stone and construction product line features diamond saw blades, portable cutters, wire saws, polishing wheels, core drills, and bits. Rounding out their comprehensive selection are jewelries and diamond powders.
